subtitle: A static camera screen rendered from OctoScript L0
description: A static L0 rendering of a camera photo-mode screen, including Chinese labels, zoom steps and camera-style controls. This is a rendering and publishing sample: it does not open the camera, take photos, change modes or save images. No device permissions, network access or assistant are requested.
release_notes: Corrects release receipt wording for issue-first submission. GitHub creates the signed release; administrator review separately admits it to the Hub. Static camera rendering and permissions are unchanged.
